Keep the upper clipped black-and-navy shape, central gray/black angular spectacles with straight brown bridge, the little pink areas, the lower split black/navy patches and the gray sole. Preserve exactly the existing source boundaries of the wide pale lavender ice facet and its blue lower-right inner facet. No added cracks or reflections.

Image2 is the neighboring phase1921 already painted in this project. It shows the intended smooth style and opacity ONLY: do NOT copy its narrower25percent slice or alter image1's geometry to match it. Image3 is approved cartoon STYLE ONLY, do not draw the rabbit or its features. This is the opaque ice holding parts of Conroy and Lee Harvey in their brown disguise. Opaque flat ice inside, genuine transparent alpha only outside.

Paint only one sprite, same framing as image1, with clean smoothly curved boundaries instead of square pixel stair steps, flat source colors and source shading only. No gradients, new contour embellishments, texture, fur strands, extra fingers, teeth, eyes, features or completion of the clipped figure. All little islands are intentional and must remain. Do not rotate, stretch or redesign, and do not paste original pixel fragments. Transparent canvas, no background, guides, labels, marks, frames, checkerboard or watermark.
